# Tiled import fixtures

- `tileset.png` and `macroquad_map.tmj` (renamed from `map.json`) are from macroquad's `examples/`
  (https://github.com/not-fl3/macroquad, commit 8d602d3), Copyright (c) 2019-2021 Fedor Logachev,
  MIT OR Apache-2.0, used under the MIT licence. They are test data only and are not shipped.
- `sample.tmx` and `terrain.tsx` were written for Regia Engine (generated by hand for the 2D-toolkit lane)
  over that tileset: an external tileset, a CSV layer, a base64+zlib layer inside a group, horizontal,
  vertical and diagonal flips, an animated tile, `solid` / `one_way` collision, map, layer and object
  properties, and an object layer.
